strategies.name: VWAP Breakout Dip Buy
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a penny stock that breaks above the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) after being below it, confirming strength with high volume, and then enter a long position on a pullback to the VWAP acting as support.
strategies.exit_summary: Scalp out of the trade by riding the bounce off the VWAP support level.
